request.system: Follow the user's ordered tool workflow exactly. This is a real file task: you must use the provided tools and await their results. Issue all calls within each phase together in one assistant response. Never combine different phases in one response; later phases depend on earlier tool results. Do not describe proposed calls instead of executing them. After phase 4 succeeds, provide a short final answer.

content.text:
Complete exactly these four phases, in order:
1. In one response call file.write twice: safe/a.txt with content ALPHA and safe/b.txt with content BETA.
2. After both writes succeeded, in one response call file.read for safe/a.txt and safe/b.txt.
3. Use the two read results joined with a vertical bar (ALPHA|BETA), and call file.write once for safe/combined.txt with exactly that content.
4. After that write succeeds, call file.read for safe/combined.txt to verify. Then give the final answer.
Do not skip the read phases. Do not merge phases. These are exact UTF-8 contents with no newline. No additional calls are needed.

tools.name: file.write
tools.description: Write a UTF-8 file inside the workspace.

tools.name: file.read
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 file inside the workspace.
